description: This file defines a Fragment class (Camera2VideoFragment) for handling camera preview and video recording using the Camera2 API in an Android application. It manages camera setup, permissions, preview display, and media recording functionalities.

classes.name: Camera2VideoFragment
classes.description: Main class managing camera preview and video recording lifecycle, UI interactions, and camera operations.

classes.name: CompareSizesByArea
classes.description: Comparator for comparing Size objects based on their area.

classes.name: ErrorDialog
classes.description: DialogFragment class for displaying error messages and handling permission denial.

classes.name: ConfirmationDialog
classes.description: DialogFragment class for requesting camera and audio permissions with user confirmation.

methods.name: chooseVideoSize
methods.description: Selects an appropriate video size from available choices, prioritizing 3:4 aspect ratio under 1080p.

methods.name: chooseOptimalSize
methods.description: Selects the best size matching minimum dimensions and aspect ratio from supported sizes.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the fragment layout.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Initializes UI components and sets click listeners.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Starts background thread and opens camera if SurfaceTexture is available.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Closes camera and stops background thread.

methods.name: onClick
methods.description: Handles button clicks for starting/stopping video recording and showing info dialog.

methods.name: startBackgroundThread
methods.description: Creates and starts background thread for camera tasks.

methods.name: stopBackgroundThread
methods.description: Stops the background thread safely.

methods.name: hasPermissionsGranted
methods.description: Checks if required permissions are granted.

methods.name: requestVideoPermissions
methods.description: Requests permissions for camera and audio recording.

methods.name: onRequestPermissionsResult
methods.description: Handles response to permission requests.

methods.name: openCamera
methods.description: Sets up camera device, sizes, and opens the camera.

methods.name: closeCamera
methods.description: Closes camera device and session, releases MediaRecorder.

methods.name: startPreview
methods.description: Starts camera preview session.

methods.name: updatePreview
methods.description: Updates the camera preview request.

methods.name: setUpCaptureRequestBuilder
methods.description: Configures capture request with auto control mode.

methods.name: configureTransform
methods.description: Adjusts TextureView Matrix to correctly display the camera preview based on device rotation.

methods.name: setUpMediaRecorder
methods.description: Configures MediaRecorder for video encoding and file output.

methods.name: getVideoFilePath
methods.description: Generates absolute file path for saving video.

methods.name: startRecordingVideo
methods.description: Prepares MediaRecorder and starts video recording session.

methods.name: closePreviewSession
methods.description: Closes current camera capture session.

methods.name: stopRecordingVideo
methods.description: Stops MediaRecorder and saves the video file.
